primary.source: RC-16A capture by Kobe beef, audiosciencereview.com/forum/index.php?threads/remote-codes-for-topping.10708/post-1395127 (2022-11-29, page 2 of the thread, #26): 'A: 5AA520DF' in a C++ comment headed 'Topping RC-16A', captured with an ATOM Lite and M5STACK IR unit; the post says the RC-16A 'bundled with MX5 is not compatible with RC-15A'. The values use the same print order as the RC-15A post it builds on (MSB-first), which the RC-15A's Verified functions confirm for every low byte here; reversed per byte, 5AA520DF is D=0x5A S=0xA5 F=0x04 ~F=0xFB. Official label and function: Topping MX5 quick guide (dl.topping.audio/usermanual/mx5.pdf, page 2, Remote control), 4-5 'Treble setting'. Single source, not cross-checked: the post's low bytes are those halfSpinDoctor posted for the RC-15A with the prefix 11EE changed to 5AA5, so a copy rather than a capture cannot be ruled out
